# `aitbc bounty deploy`

Deploy a bounty lock (queues a BOUNTY_LOCK protocol transfer).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc bounty deploy [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--bounty-id` | text | — | no | Bounty identifier (generated when omitted) |
| `--amount` | decimal | — | yes | Reward amount to lock, in AIT |
| `--user-address` | text | — | no | Creator address funding the lock (defaults to the signing wallet) |
| `--memo` | text | — | no | Optional description carried in the signed body |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--wallet-name` | text | — | no | Operator wallet that signs the request (its address must be the node's operator address) |
| `--wallet-path` | text | — | no | Direct path to operator wallet file (overrides --wallet-name) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL (overrides config) |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to sign with (skips auto-detection) |
| `--json` | flag | `false` | no | Emit the result as JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc bounty deploy --amount <amount>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc bounty deploy --amount <amount> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
